title: Q5® Site-Directed Mutagenesis
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bddfi23n
materials: Assemble the following reagents in a thin-walled PCR tube. A B C 1 25 μl RXN FINAL CONC. 2 Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix 12.5 μl 1X 3 10 μM Forward Primer 1.25 μl 0.5 μM 4 10 μM Reverse Primer 1.25 μl 0.5 μM 5 Template DNA (1–25 ng/μl) 1 μl 1-25 ng 6 Nuclease-free water 9.0 μl 25 μl RXN FINAL CONC. Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix 12.5 μl 1X 10 μM Forward Primer 1.25 μl 0.5 μM 10 μM Reverse Primer 1.25 μl 0.5 μM Template DNA (1–25 ng/μl) 1 μl 1-25 ng Nuclease-free water 9.0 μl
Assemble the following reagents: A B C 1 VOLUME FINAL CONC. 2 PCR Product 1 μl 3 2X KLD Reaction Buffer 5 μl 1X 4 10X KLD Enzyme Mix 1 μl 1X 5 Nuclease-free Water 3 μl
Thaw a tube of NEB 5-alpha Competent E. coli cells On ice .

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Transfer the reaction to a thermocycler and run the following cycling conditions:

substeps.instruction: 25 Cycles of: 98°C for 10 seconds, 50–72°C* for 10–30 seconds, and 72°C for 20–30 seconds/kb
*Note: Use NEBaseChanger™ for optimized annealing temperature or apply Ta = Tm + 3 for pre-designed back-to-back primer sets.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Transformation
steps.instruction: Prepare the thawed cells and add the KLD mix.

substeps.instruction: Mix well by pipetting up and down
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes
Add 5 µL of KLD mix to the tube of thawed cells
Carefully flick the tube 4-5 times to mix (do not vortex)

steps.title: Incubate and Heat Shock
steps.instruction: Perform the transformation heat shock sequence.

substeps.instruction: Place the mixture on ice for 30 minutes

steps.title: Outgrowth and Plating
steps.instruction: Recover the cells and plate them for selection.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 950 µL of room temperature SOC into the mixture
Incubate at 37°C for 1 hour with shaking at 250 rpm
Mix cells thoroughly by flicking the tube and inverting
Spread 50 µL - 100 µL onto a selection plate (consider a 10- to 40-fold dilution in SOC prior to plating for simple substitution/deletion experiments to avoid colony lawns)
